summary: Iteration 7 QA AUDIT — no product changes. Full regression suite (test_taxsimba_phase1/1b/1b_ux/phase2/iteration6_retest) = 116 passed / 3 skipped / 0 failed. New targeted audit suite /app/backend/tests/test_iteration7_audit.py (18 tests) confirms both suspected defects the main agent flagged and probes SECTION 2/3/4/6/7/8/9. 15/18 passed, 3 FAILED — each failure is a genuine product defect with reproducible evidence: (1) DUPLICATE MTD RECOMMENDATIONS — no guard in _create_recommendation (phase1b.py:540-574), a second POST /api/cases/{id}/recommend-mtd while one is still PENDING is accepted and inserted, leaving TWO PENDING MTD recommendations against the same case. (2) DUPLICATE PACKAGE RECOMMENDATIONS — same code path, same missing guard; a second /api/cases/{id}/recommend-package for the same target package while one is PENDING is accepted. (3) DUPLICATE-PAYMENT PROTECTION for upgrades — two /api/payments/upgrade-checkout calls back-to-back for the same client + same target package both succeed and both return distinct Stripe session IDs; the `fulfilled` idempotency flag is keyed on session_id so if the client completes both checkouts the SA upgrade is 'applied' twice (state is idempotent to package_code but package_history gets a second entry and the client is charged twice; the offer-checkout flow has the same shape and would create a second MTD case on second fulfilment). Non-defects confirmed: no 'Explore Services' area in the codebase (grep -rni across /app/frontend/src returns zero hits); accountant is 403 on /api/users, /api/payments, /api/my-payments, /api/my-services, /api/overview, /api/recommendations; cross-accountant case IDOR blocked (403/404); accountant case detail does NOT leak email/phone/utr/address/client_user_id/password_hash/session_id; deactivated user's existing token is rejected (401) via /api/users/{id}/active?is_active=false; workflow stage-skip blocked in all three probed transitions (submit-for-admin-review from ASSIGNED, client-approve before admin approval, record-submission before READY); downgrade AND equal-package upgrade-checkout both rejected 400; cross-client document download returns 403/404.

critical.issue: No guard prevents a second PENDING (or APPROVED) MTD recommendation for the same case/service. Reproduced: two consecutive calls both return 200 and both rows exist with status=PENDING. Fix: in phase1b._create_recommendation, before insert do `if await db.recommendations.find_one({case_id, service_type/type, status: {$in: ['PENDING','APPROVED']}}): raise HTTPException(409, 'A recommendation for this service is already pending/approved on this case')`.
Same missing duplicate guard — a second PACKAGE_UPGRADE recommendation for the same case is accepted. Fix as above (same helper _create_recommendation).

Duplicate-payment protection is only per-session (`fulfilled` flag on payment_transactions.session_id). Two concurrent checkout sessions can be created for the SAME client+target upgrade or the SAME offer_id — both are payable via Stripe. Confirmed for upgrade-checkout: session IDs cs_test_a1bThHJz... and cs_test_a1Y97HZN... both created for the same fresh SA client's ELITE upgrade. If the client completes both, _fulfil runs twice (different session records, both `fulfilled=false`), producing a second package_history entry and — for SERVICE_ACTIVATION — a second case row. Fix: reject a new checkout when db.payment_transactions has an in-flight (status='initiated' or payment_status!='paid') record for the same client_id + kind + new_package (upgrade) or offer_id (activation); alternatively mark the offer 'RESERVED' at checkout creation and block further checkouts until the reservation expires/fails.

action_items: Add duplicate-recommendation guard in phase1b._create_recommendation covering both PACKAGE_UPGRADE and MTD types (reject if a PENDING or APPROVED recommendation of the same type already exists for the case).

Add duplicate-payment guard in phase1b.upgrade_checkout and phase1b.offer_checkout: block a new checkout when there is an in-flight payment_transactions row for the same client+target/offer (or mark the offer 'RESERVED' during checkout creation).
(Nice-to-have, spotted by iteration 6): move `offer-explanation` and `rec-explanation` testids onto the same visible node instead of duplicating copy in a hidden span.
critical_code_review_comments: phase1b._create_recommendation has no idempotency at all — any accountant can flood a case with recommendations. Beyond duplicate blocking, also consider throttling.

_fulfil idempotency is per session_id via `fulfilled` — this protects against Stripe webhook retries but not against multiple sessions. The business-key idempotency needs to be at the level of (client, kind, new_package) for upgrades and (offer_id) for activations.
phase1b.py is now 745 lines, server.py 1158 lines — both approaching the 700-line split threshold; recommend extracting payments and recommendations into their own modules.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' in backend/.env combined with cookie auth remains a carry-over risk if cookies are ever used cross-origin.
No login lockout / brute-force protection on POST /api/auth/login — carry-over.
